WITH store_tn AS (
    SELECT s_store_sk, s_state
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state = 'TN'
),
cd_matching AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'M'
      AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
),
date_1999 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
)
SELECT rolled.i_item_id, rolled.s_state, rolled.g_state,
       rolled.agg1, rolled.agg2, rolled.agg3, rolled.agg4
FROM (
    SELECT i.i_item_id,
           st.s_state,
           GROUPING(st.s_state) AS g_state,
           AVG(ss.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
           AVG(ss.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
           AVG(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
           AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN store_tn AS st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    JOIN cd_matching AS cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_1999 AS dt ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dt.d_date_sk
    JOIN item AS i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, st.s_state WITH ROLLUP
) AS rolled
ORDER BY rolled.i_item_id, rolled.s_state
LIMIT 100
